prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: orthographic four-view concept turnaround for reconstructing ONE game environment cargo winch hoist with local Hunyuan3D multi-view.
Create a wide 2048x1024 image with exactly four isolated views of the same object in one horizontal row: FRONT, LEFT, BACK, RIGHT, with NO written labels. Plain pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow. Each view has the same scale, full 3.5 metre vertical height and aligned baseline. Leave clean white margins and space between the views. Orthographic projection only, no perspective or three-quarter views.
Subject: one compact, short, stout wooden cargo winch/hoist, approximately 3 metres wide, 2.5 metres deep, 3.5 metres high. A thick continuous rectangular timber foundation, two massive timber side supports with broad diagonal braces, a chunky connected upper crossbeam, and a very broad horizontal wooden cable drum between the supports. The drum has a few thick simplified dark rope windings carved as broad bands, fully joined into the reel volume. A large readable solid hand-crank wheel is fixed to the RIGHT end of the axle: a thick wooden disk with three shallow broad recessed wedge motifs, dark iron rim and one thick short crank handle, NOT a thin spoked wheel. Front shows the drum and frame. Rear has a broad lower cross brace. Both side views clearly show depth of the foundation, triangular frame support, axle and the appropriate side of the wheel. All four views must depict mechanically consistent parts and the wheel on the same physical side.
Style: stylized hand-painted fantasy FPS environment at Gunfire Reborn level of readable moderate game detail. Bold chunky silhouette, clean faceted timber, gently chamfered solid edges, warm dark honey-brown wood, charcoal iron fasteners and muted ochre painted wear. Two or three coherent large color blocks, broad soft painted gradients and sparse restrained edge accents. Matte finish and even neutral studio light.
Constraints: one connected complete solid prop with sturdy full volume. The reel, wheel and supports must be at least thick enough to survive a low-poly game mesh. No hanging thin ropes, chains, pulley cables, suspended cargo, hook, fine lattice, tiny bolts, loose objects, floating pieces, dramatic snow, fire, glowing runes, weather effects, text, symbols, ground plane or baked cast shadow. The bottom is flat, continuous and weight-bearing. Avoid intricate ornament, wood micro-grain, photorealism and surface noise. Do not draw four different designs.
